mutants.name: M6-revert-to-pre-validation-short-circuit
mutants.why: Defect A': reverting to a pre-validation short-circuit re-introduces the 100029 regression — a v0.1 conformant register returns LEGACY_SCHEMA with empty rows instead of staying CONFORMANT. The whole plan is VALIDATE FIRST, EXEMPT SECOND; this mutant breaks it. Killed by test 1.
